title: Equivalent Bicommutant Categories from Nonisomorphic Conformal Nets
exact_target: Can large families of distinct conformal nets share equivalent associated bicommutant tensor categories?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004279 (OWR-17292-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Applications (2019), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2019/49, pp. 3053--3140. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 23, 24.
Henriques--Penneys, representations of fusion categories and commutants (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Henriques--Penneys--Tener, finite-depth objects in bicommutant categories (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The size and parameterization of large families and the precise associated category must be the report\textquotesingle s definitions. The question concerns equivalence of that category, not merely equality of numerical invariants or representation-ring dimensions.
